case_status_semantics.actual_status_semantics: golden case assertion status; describes whether the golden assertion held. Allowed values: pass, skipped_with_reason_code, advisory.
case_status_semantics.expected_status_semantics: expected golden case assertion status; same allowed enum as actual_status.
case_status_semantics.observed_cli_status_semantics: observed runner / harness CLI outcome classification for the case. Allowed values: pass, fail, skipped_with_reason_code, advisory, exit_2_load_failed, exit_2_invalid_task_id.
case_status_semantics.expected_cli_status_semantics: expected observed CLI outcome for the case; same allowed enum as observed_cli_status.
case_status_semantics.case_pass_semantics: boolean true iff observed CLI behavior matched the golden contract (exit code, json subset, reason_code, stderr, expected_cli_status).
case_status_semantics.repair_history: v3.5.5 closure review FAIL: actual_status formerly carried negative CLI outcomes (fail / exit_2_load_failed / exit_2_invalid_task_id). TASK-1037 repair separates assertion status from CLI outcome status: actual_status now restricted to {pass, skipped_with_reason_code, advisory}; observed_cli_status / expected_cli_status added to preserve negative CLI outcomes.

preferred_contracts: stable check_id / gate_id set lock (PCACC-001..004; QC-SYNC-001 / QC-SCHEMA-001 / QC-IMPORT-001 / QC-GOLDEN-001 / QC-RUFF-001)
stable status enum lock (pass / fail / skipped_with_reason_code; plus advisory for QC-IMPORT-001 / QC-RUFF-001)
stable reason_code literal or stable reason_code prefix lock per case
stderr empty unless explicitly justified per case
no __pycache__ or *.pyc produced under fixture root or harness directory
rejected_contracts: brittle full-stdout byte-equality (would break on Taipei timestamp, JSON key reordering, fixture path interpolation)
matching against actual paths or absolute filesystem locations
matching against `actual` free-form descriptors that aggregate counts or stderr tails

output_contract_strategy.stdout_strategy: JSON-only stdout; harness asserts json.loads(stdout) succeeds and that the locked field subset equals expected literals or expected prefix.
output_contract_strategy.stderr_strategy: empty by default for both runners; cases with non-empty stderr must record the justification in the case manifest.
output_contract_strategy.json_strategy: subset assertion against locked fields; generated_at is always excluded from the lock; actual strings that include counts or path interpolation are excluded unless explicitly listed.
output_contract_strategy.reason_code_strategy: exact literal match for stable reason_codes; prefix match for templated codes (e.g. lifecycle_missing:<kinds>, malformed_refs:<token>, post_baseline_new_pair_drift).
output_contract_strategy.cache_strategy: harness sets sys.dont_write_bytecode=True; subprocess env contains PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; subprocess argv uses python -B; post-run sweep over artifacts/verify/TASK-1037/ asserts zero __pycache__ / *.pyc.

fixture_strategy.fixture_layout: fixtures/<surface>-<group-tail>-<NNN>/repo/{artifacts,template,...} per case; PCACC fail-closed registries shared under fixtures/pcacc/registries/.
fixture_strategy.fixture_repo_root_strategy: Each fixture repo contains the consilium-fabri-governance-repair-plan-v3.5.md sentinel + artifacts/governance/ + template/ so the runner's detect_repo_root() resolves to the fixture root. The runner is invoked as a fixture-local byte-identical copy at artifacts/scripts/run_precommit_check.py or run_quality_gates.py to ensure SCRIPT_PATH.parents lands inside the fixture tree.
fixture_strategy.policy_override_strategy: harness passes --policy and --baseline pointing at fixture-local copies; production policy and baseline are never consumed by tests.
fixture_strategy.registry_override_strategy: harness passes --evidence-ref-policy pointing at fixture-local copies for EVREF + FAILCLOSED groups; controlled malformed registries live under fixtures/pcacc/registries/ and never under artifacts/governance/.
fixture_strategy.timestamp_strategy: fixtures inline deterministic Taipei ISO 8601 timestamps; runner-emitted generated_at is excluded from the byte lock.

limitations: Twenty-four cases are implemented; remaining matrix cases (SYNC-003 / 005 / 006, SCHEMA-003 / 004, IMPORT-001 / 002 / 004, GOLDEN-002, RUFF-002) are recorded with implementation_status=implemented_with_limitations and a per-case limitation_reason. They remain candidates for a future lifecycle.
Reason_code surface is anchored at PCACC sha=4dbb8a219093cc12 and quality sha=456b8328482b18a5; future runner edits will require a separate refresh task.

Per-case fixture repo includes byte-identical copies of the production runner under artifacts/scripts/ to guarantee SCRIPT_PATH.parents lands in the fixture root; the copy is not a runtime modification of the production runner.

Quality runner Pass-2 discover_current_pairs detects the runner self-pair as post_baseline_new_pair_in_sync; harness asserts case-specific QC-SYNC-001 check by target path to avoid coupling to the runner self-pair.
QC-SCHEMA-001 reads minimum_required_targets from fixed paths under repo root; per-case fixture provides deterministic stubs for all six required JSON targets to keep the gate well-defined.
ORC marker matching is substring against verify text (`evidence_refs_optional_per_orc_<id>`); future tightening into a structured heading would require both runner and harness to re-anchor.
Result JSON production_preservation block reports sha256 prefix only (first 16 hex chars); full 64-char comparison is not duplicated here.

TASK-1037 repair (status semantics): per-case schema separates assertion status (actual_status / expected_status; allowed pass / skipped_with_reason_code / advisory) from CLI outcome status (observed_cli_status / expected_cli_status; allowed pass / fail / skipped_with_reason_code / advisory / exit_2_load_failed / exit_2_invalid_task_id). Negative CLI cases preserve former fail / exit_2_* observations under observed_cli_status; pass=true iff observed CLI behavior matched the golden contract.
